description: Path traversal and remote code execution in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49 only. A flaw in path normalization allows an unauthenticated attacker to map URLs outside document root.
impact: Unauthenticated path traversal and potential RCE when mod_cgi is enabled.
preconditions: Filesystem directory configured without 'require all denied'

description: Path traversal and RCE in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49/2.4.50. Incomplete fix for CVE-2021-41773 — further encoding bypass allows traversal and potential code execution.
impact: Remote code execution via double-encoding path traversal bypass.

description: Apache HTTP Server 2.2.x before 2.2.33: mod_mime buffer overread allows attacker to cause a heap buffer overread via a malicious request.
impact: Heap buffer overread leading to information disclosure or potential crash.
